items.title: Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution (RCE)
items.summary: This zero-day vulnerability allows unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source installations, with active exploitation confirmed in the wild.

items.title: Security update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities that could lead to arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, and security feature bypass.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This regularly scheduled security update addresses critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, including arbitrary code execution, arbitrary file system read, security feature bypass, and privilege escalation.

items.title: Unauthenticated Customer Account Takeover and other vulnerabilities
items.summary: This bulletin addresses seven vulnerabilities, including a critical unauthenticated customer account takeover with a CVSS score of 9.1, allowing attackers to gain elevated access to sensitive resources.
